card.name: Words just before a listed symptom
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation right before the next item in a list of clinical signs, such as 'in some cases' or a comma before 'hypotension'. Also fires on 'may', 'are' or 'symptoms' just before a predicate or condition.

modes.label: Linking verbs
modes.description: A modal or linking verb after a subject, ahead of the stated outcome or condition.
modes.example: black hats anticipate that their sites<< may>> eventually be banned either temporarily or permanently once

modes.description: The digit 0 beginning a decimal concentration value.
